en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  Imam Musa Kadhim (a.s.) said, “A believer of Bani Israel had a neighbor who was an infidel and he used to behave very well with the believer and performed good deeds in the world. When the infidel died, Allah built for him a house of mud in Hell which protected him from its heat and provided him  sustenance  from  elsewhere.  He  was  told,  ‘You  are getting these comforts because of your nice behavior with your so and so believing neighbor and doing good in the world’.”
